XData.name: DTL
XData.Data:
<transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='AdtAmWellHl7:AmWellAdt' targetDocType='AdtAmWellHl7:AmWellAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Translates A04 and A03s from AmWell to CDR for Guarantors</annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='"AMWELL"' property='target.{MSH:SendingFacility.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"AmWell"' property='target.{MSH:SendingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CDR"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='"A04"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):SetIDGT1}' property='target.{PID:SetIDPID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorNumber(1).ID}' property='target.{PID:PatientIdentifierList(1).ID}' action='set' /> <assign value='$TR(source.{GT1(1):GuarantorName(1).familyname.surname},".","")' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).familyname.surname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorName(1).givenname}' property='target.{PID:PatientName(1).givenname}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorDateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' property='target.{PID:DateTimeOfBirth.timeofanevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAdministrativeSex}' property='target.{PID:AdministrativeSex}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).streetaddressSAD}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).streetaddressSAD}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).otherdesignation}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).otherdesignation}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).city}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).city}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).stateorprovince}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).stateorprovince}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).ziporpostalcode}' action='set' /> <assign value='"Home Address"' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(1).addresstype}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorPhNumHome(1).phonenumber1}' property='srcPhNumber' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(srcPhNumber) > 9' > <true> <assign value='"("_$extract(srcPhNumber,1,3)_")"_$extract(srcPhNumber,4,6)_"-"_$extract(srcPhNumber,7,$length(srcPhNumber))' property='phNumUpdated' action='set' /> <assign value='phNumUpdated' property='target.{PID:PhoneNumberHome(1).phonenumber1}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{GT1(1):GuarantorEmployerPhoneNumber(1).Emailaddress}' property='emailAddress' action='set' /> <if condition='$length(emailAddress) > 0' > <true> <assign value='emailAddress' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).streetaddressSAD.streetormailingaddress}' action='set' /> <assign value='"Primary Home Email Address"' property='target.{PID:PatientAddress(2).addresstype}' action='set' /> </true> </if>
</transform>
